about_the_game:
Witch: Journey to the End is a cooperative multiplayer card Roguelite game with role-playing elements. Form a Witch Squad with your buddies and come destroy the world to the ground~!

> As symbols of the ominous, the Witches are veritable stars of calamity, and in Aldrin, their presence means only one thing: the world is coming to an end.

> They are both executioners and morticians, leading the footsteps of the Witches as they give the world its last ride!

Join your friends in the guise of a witch, or recruit a squad of NPCs!

> Players can form a team of up to four witches to experience the fun of strategy cards.

>You can also recruit other NPCs to replenish your strength during the events. Death is not the end of the road, and you can return to the battlefield with a mouthful of milk!

Build your own magic and customize your cards with a high degree of freedom!

> In addition to the cards you may obtain in the game, you will have the opportunity to obtain “Blank Cards”.

> By writing a unique combination of magic spells on a blank card, you can create your own unique “Exclusive Deck”!

> Don't want a certain card to appear in the game ......? Replace it with your own!

Write your own destiny and freely choose the nodes on the map you will encounter!

> Witches can't reverse time, but they can manipulate karma.

> Draw a certain number of fate cards from the map screen and arrange them on the timeline as you wish.

> Once you have decided on a route, the next move will be as you envisioned it.

Make rational resource deployment and develop targeted strategies based on the characteristics of your enemies.

> In the game, you can obtain a variety of resources to strengthen your witch.

> Construct your basic deck with cards, build your genre with relics, and strengthen your attributes with blessings.

> You will encounter enemies with different special abilities, to restrain or be restrained, depending on your choice.

Alchemical synthesis, card enchantment

> Purchase materials from the Witch's House with the Crystal of Truth obtained from your adventures, and put them into the Alchemy Table to create new products.

> The finished product can be enchanted to temporarily change the effect of a card for one game.

> Craft a 0-cost overcard, or focus all your damage on one card to create a “magic bomb”, where resources are power.

Witch's Quest ...... and my choices

> The extermination of the world is the vocation of a witch, but it may not be the path I choose for myself.

> Witches with different experiences and personalities converge on Aldrin, guiding them to fulfill their mission, or liberate their nature? In any case, the choice is now in your hands.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 1.6 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 能响就行

short_description: As the Abyss decays, the Witches of the End descend upon Aldrin. You, as the master of the witches, will guide their way, and will encounter the survivalist resistance of the world's will. Will you play an elegy for the world, or will you find the root of the decay and create hope out of despair...?

English, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
